newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Midas pays HK$55 mln for printing firm.
newsitem.headline: Midas pays HK$55 mln for printing firm.

text.p: Midas Printing Group Ltd said on Friday it has agreed to purchase the entire issued share capital of Dah Hua Printing Press Co Ltd from YGM Printing Inc and its directors for a total of HK$55 million.
Dah Hua was 80 percent held by YGM Printing, a wholly-owned subsidiary of YGM Trading Ltd, and 20 percent owned by several directors of YGM Printing, it said in a statement.
Midas said it would pay HK$33 million in cash and HK$22 million by the allotment to YGM Printing of 18.64 million Midas shares at HK$1.18 in the deal.
Application had been made to reusme trading of Midas shares on Friday after one day's suspension.
The issue price of HK$1.18 per consideration share represented a premium of about 31.11 percent to the closing prices of Midas shares of HK$0.90 per shares on Wednesday.
